# Requirements Quality Checklist: Tab Title Shows Data State

**Purpose**: Check whether the tab-title requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable (focus: data-state mapping and edge cases; depth: standard; audience: PR reviewer)
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.checklist`.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. It does not mean implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact title strings for all three states specified, including the separator character and spacing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the title when the console loses its connection to the backend (the badge shows "sin conexión" while the last status stays cached)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the title requirement stated for the contingency mode described in the constitution? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "unrecognized status" defined (any value outside live/estimated/no_data, or also null/empty)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "within the same refresh" quantified or tied to a defined refresh cycle? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "until the console applies a state" distinguished clearly from "before the first response, the title is Sin datos"? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Does the unrecognized-status rule (title = Sin datos) agree with the badge's behavior for the same value, given FR-001 requires title and badge to match? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the feature branch name consistent between spec (`feature/56-cadena`) and plan (`008-tab-title-data-state`)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Can SC-001 ("matches the header badge in 100 % of states") be measured by the tests FR-004 requires, which cover the mapping only? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the SC-003 coverage threshold scoped to the changed files or the whole frontend? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for the title when status changes rapidly between states (flapping)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the title behavior defined when the component unmounts (restore or keep the last title)? [Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Are accessibility expectations for title text (screen-reader announcement of tab titles, non-colour state cue) addressed or explicitly out of scope? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the title language (Spanish labels in an English-language repository) documented as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK015 Is the assumption that the badge's three labels are the single source of truth validated against the current badge implementation? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the criterion is satisfied
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist state and must not modify markers
